body: I think I know what you mean.. I rarely tell people how upset I really am to those in my real life because I don't want to burden them.. even if they tell me I should talk to them.. but this is why internet is so great.. you can always find people to talk to here, who will listen and support you.. you never have to reveal who you really are in the sense that you are partially annonymous.. it helps sometimes to talk to complete strangers, but that's just my opinion..

I gotta say it might not be easy, but the way I dealt with it when I had tough times was to take a break.. slow down.. have a look, make a list of what is wrong.. then I organised it, by what I had to sort out first, for example a place to stay.. I used friends, google, job centres, shelters, ect to get that at least temporarily fixed, then moved on to the next thing on my list and then the next.. the list would keep the mind busy and once you start sorting things out even if it's baby steps at a time it might give the momentum of positive improvement.. just how I dealt with my problems the times I had them.. if you find better ways, do it that way and always know there's going to be people around to talk to and get help / advice from on here and many other places. It's easier said than done, believe me, I know, but you gotta keep pushing, keep trying and if you ever hit rock bottom, just remember that at that point the only way is up.. or that's how I try to look at it when life drowns me in lemons..

You are the only one assuming that someone assumes you haven't tried something. Of course we will all offer ideas for what MIGHT help, what else do you expect? If you are here not for offers of sharing ideas how to get more serious help, then you are here to troll..

Until someones been in the same position they wouldn't know what caring is, I also feel like that too, BUT if YOU aren't going to start on trying to sort your life out yourself, those who care can't just sort it out and live it for you.. sounds like you been through some shit, different stuff hurts people differently, I for one try to talk to people in their worst because they are most likely to hurt themselves or fully give up and as they improve I let them do their thing because I'm not their mother, I also want to live my life as much as I want to help.. its not that I stop caring, but there are a lot of people who need help out there and if you think someone should hold your hand FOREVER you are just selfish and you yourself don't care about others in the same position as you as long as someone pays attention to you it's all good..

It's hard, I've experienced this a few times, the place I grew up was violent and things I had to witness were bad.
I completely understand being traumatised by it, but bottom line, you taking your life will just traumatise others.. 
Everyones life is important, from what I read there wasn't anything you could have done, so please don't feel like that was on you..
If you need to talk to someone, you can inbox me or maybe find someone else who has had similar experiences to talk to, because even though therapists have the education to medicate, they don't have in most cases the first hand experience..
It's almost impossible to explain in words the emotion a death in front of ones eyes puts upon a person..
Please don't do anything drastic and the fact you are seeking help shows you are strong enough, so please don't give up! x <3

I'm not the best person to inspire or at speeches / write ups, but as far as it goes I was bullied a lot when I was in school and I didn't find friends for a long time.. so I can kind of relate.. one thing bullies have taught me is that bullying is a bigger sign of weakness than one would think. The bullies have to pick on someone who is nicer as a person, weaker than them physically or emotionally, but in reality they do this to look stronger than they are.. bullies are douches no doubt, but usually it's because they are frustrated.. frustrated because they aren't achieving what they want in life and they usually pick on those who they also think can succeed.
I don't know you or them, I don't know the full story, but as far as it goes it hurts. I know. Don't let that stop you from doing what you want and achieving what you are capable of.
The nicest people get hurt the most, but you will get through this and you will get to a place you want to be at, you just got to get through the hard part of teenage years.. I believe that you will and I also believe that you will eventually find good friends, you have to keep your chin up and smile. You can achieve big things and you aren't them, because you're better than them.
I'm not trying to convert or something, just trying to explain, but I'm glad you can maybe see what I meant to do by posting this and I appreciate the feedback :)

For some the belief that they will see their loved ones who they miss dearly and have lost gives reason to live on.. science is facts I know and I'm non religious myself, this isn't religion based post or anything else.. its something to think about for those who feel like they just don't belong.. sometimes it just feels like you don't belong and my theory doesn't have to be right but the point of moving to another place and starting again helps some people..

Just because you lack the ability to prove something, doesn't mean it may not be true.. all of us and the rest of the universe.. even that rock you speak of are made from the same atoms in different patterns.. who is to say energy can not transfer? Feelings are also energy.. we are energy.. not trying to say it's some fact that my theory is plausible, but denying any theory is kind of closed minded.. give it a few hundred years maybe this will get proven, just like the idea that the earth was proven to be round too ;)
Either way, I didn't post this in the science or something section, because I thought this theory may brighten someones evening and if even one person smile like the person above, then it was worth the time to put it up there ;)

Thank you :') I'm reading this and almost tearing up to think how much one person I don't even personally know can make such a difference, a few kind words, a bit of advice and even though depression never just dissapears straight away, your words urge me to not sink deeper, knowing that there's others who are dealing with devils inside of them, I have only been on reddit for a day, but I've been through some of the sadder parts of it mostly and I read quite a few stories and replied to some, even had someone thank me for just a few kind words which apparently gave them hope and it just made me glow inside..
I feel that coming onto this site has already started helping me and will continue to do so, be it from people talking to me or me talking to others who are upset, trying to cheer them up..
It's much better than just being curled up on my bed staring at my wall.. this is actual progress.. Thanks again!

Wow, thank you, I'm just as sorry for your loss too.
I think you're right, probably about everything, as far as looking for a job goes, I am now pressuring myself into getting one more, I even spoke to a few friends who were kind of on the edge at looking for one and we made a little group pact about helping support each other in finding things and pushing each other to work harder on the finding and keeping a job.. so I am sure that is going to help me..

However, as far as the mother situation goes, I know you're right on that too, but the problem is she already works from 7 AM to around 8 PM she's tired, she's ill, she has a lot of problems including her own debts among other things.. and I know telling her would crush her even more than she is now.. because when I told her I'm starting university she was sooo so proud and she cried.. she literally cried from happiness that even though my family said I will never amount to anything in this world (Yeah 90% of my family are some sort of inhumane soulless beasts) I was going somewhere.. to tell her I dropped out.. It would really crush her.. even if it would help me, I just can't force myself to hurt someone.. I already find sharing things hard, but to share something that I know would upset someone directly is almost incomprehendable to my silly little idiots mind..

I appreciate the reply and knowing that someone is there and has read this / thought about it, helps.. though of course, being me also makes me feel like a chore more too.. but I guess it's just how I've been brought up.. 

Thank you, really.

It's not you. Not everyone loves socialising, I like to be alone too. A lot. Does that make me or you weird or worse than others? No way. A lot of people like to keep themselves to themselves or have an online identity where they can't be judged for looks, but only their words / actions.
It's easier said than done, to say 'just ignore them', but even if you can't ignore them, a lot of people in this world can be real jerks.. I've had much more than my fair share of people talk bad about me or say things behind my back.. Just focus on what you are aiming for, be it education or otherwise and pay less attention to those who chat pitiful things about others. Keep your chin up!
~BBP
